item.title: Financial Market Design for Sustainable and Inclusive Growth
item.content:encoded:
This special issue in Global Finance Journal explores how financial market design can support sustainable and inclusive economic growth. The call invites research examining mechanisms and structures within financial markets that contribute to broader development objectives.

Appel publié par Global Finance Journal. Voir l'appel sur le site de l'éditeur. Fiche de l'appel sur kerostig.
